nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: What is the importance of external communication on legal compliance by Italian waste treatment companies in the context of sustainability?
nodes.answer: External communication on legal compliance by Italian waste treatment companies is significant as it demonstrates transparency, accountability, and adherence to regulations, thereby promoting sustainability practices.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|SMEs industrial support|Environmental compliance_qna_001
nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: Should Switzerland enforce the same strict environmental regulations on Swiss companies producing goods abroad as they do domestically?
nodes.answer: Yes, it is essential to maintain environmental standards regardless of location to ensure sustainability and responsibility.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|SMEs industrial support|Environmental compliance_qna_002
nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: What is the role of environmental permits according to the paragraph?
nodes.answer: Environmental permits are a requirement upon industrial producers and infrastructure developers.
nodes.paragraph: Keywords Climate change Environmental permits Emissions trading system Polluter pays principle Agent-based models Macro-economic dynamics JEL Classi cation C63 Q40 Q50 Q54 B Lilit Popoyan I.popoyan@qmul.ac.uk Alessandro Sapio lessandro.sapio@uniparthenope.it 1Queen Mary, University of London, Department of Business Analytics and Applied Economics, Mile End Road, London E1 4NS, UK 2Institute of Economics (LEM), Scuola Superiore Sant Anna, Piazza Martiri della Libert 33,1-56127 Pisa, Italy 3University of Naples Parthenope , Department of Business and Economics, Via Parisi 13, 80133 Napoli, Italy 123 L. Popoyan and A. Sapio 1 Introduction The Paris Agreement (COP 2015 ) made it clear that handling climate change and its effects should be on the radar of regulatory policy, suggesting the usage of mixed envi- ronmental policies that support each other, including cap-and-trade policies (Goulder and Schein 2013 ; Heine et al. 2019 ; Gon alves and Costa 2022 ), and environmental permits (Hintermann 2017 ; Kinnunen and Kaksonen 2019 ), among others. Environ- mental permit systems have been legally adopted in almost all countries in the world (Reid 2008 ; Huppes and Simonis 2009 ), as a requirement upon industrial produc- ers and infrastructure developers.
